d:
Love’s magic, now crystal clear in 8K Pyaar Tere Da Assar is the soulful romantic song from the Punjabi film Goreyan Nu Daffa Karo, sung by Prabh Gill and starring Amrinder Gill and Amrit Maghera.
Maninder Kailey wrote the lyrics and Jatinder Shah made the music. It’s a gentle love song about how deeply someone’s love can change you, and every frame is sharper than ever
Speed Records, Aman Khatkar & Arsara Films Presents
Produced By – Suresh Kumar, Monty Shoor, Sukhjinder Bhachu & Aman Khatkar
